For a team

Agents your whole crew can message.

When the business grows past you, agents on your own computer answer the shop’s inbox, chase unpaid invoices and keep jobs on the calendar for everyone. No email goes out until you approve it.

For you or your team.

A team · you are here

Up to 50 agents for $99 a month or $999 a year.

One person

One agent free at 20 jobs a day on your own AI account, or up to 10 from $30 a month. See Archie for one person.

Archie for Teams

Agents your whole team can message.

Archie for Teams installs beside Archie as its own app, with its own data and keys. Until its next release the installer still says Archie for Business. Compare both plans.

An agent each

An agent for each teammate.

Use shared agents, one each, or both. Keep confidential context off shared agents.

Nearest to your team

Customers waiting, and nobody sweeping the inbox.

  • SkillOwed to Customers Finds anyone still waiting in the shared mail.
  • SkillCommon Questions The top questions, with one agreed answer.
  • PersonalityThe Operator Leads with today’s blocker, in one line.

The week’s numbers live in four tools.

  • SkillRevenue Watch Failed and unpaid payments in your Stripe.
  • SkillWaiting On Replies that never came, invoices never paid.
  • RoutineTeam Standup A morning brief: shared calendar, unclaimed work.

Leads in four places, and quotes nobody followed up.

  • SkillLead Desk Every lead in one list, with its stage.
  • SkillCampaign Watch Who replied, and which campaign went quiet.
  • SkillBooking Watch Who booked, who moved, and what they wrote.

The same sign-ins every month, before any work.

  • SkillClean Books Drop a statement PDF and it enters every charge.
  • SkillStatement Collector Downloads each month’s statement from sites you signed in to.
  • PersonalityThe Bookkeeper The figure first, then what would move it most.

Three Business store add-ons, all included. Your agent buys only if you switch that on, at shops you pick, up to your limit. See every limit →
